digest.component_or_area: rebar.toml model class configuration and fallback orchestration
propositions: Direct Anthropic fallback arms were approved but not configured in rebar.toml because direct Sonnet was marked fail-closed, though live testing proved native structured output and thinking capability work.

The whole-chain capability intersection mechanism silently downgrades primary model capabilities to the least common denominator across fallback candidates, forcing all standard-class calls from native to prompted structured output when a fallback is configured.
Frontier and standard model classes require direct Anthropic fallback configuration in rebar.toml with measured capability rows; trivial remains single-arm until direct Haiku parity is measured.

The per-attempt request-shape redesign (adapting output_mode, caching, sampling, and tools per candidate at execution time) is approved but requires explicit orchestration beyond current FallbackModel, and is deferred to future heterogeneous chain pairs.
